resolutions: PR flow: seal on C=HEAD; write marker with sealed_commit=C; then the command runs git add <marker>, git commit -m '<KEY> <id>: task PR marker' (evidence-only), git push -u origin <branch>, gh pr create. The commit+push are the command's own authorized git ops and are REQUIRED (without them AC2's marker-on-origin/main can never hold).
Factor the seal predicates into factory_lib.require_task_sealed(root, id); pr_ready.py refactors to call the same predicates where they overlap (factored, not cloned, per 0047).

Shipped truth = the exact pr-ready.json marker on refreshed origin/main (shared task_marker_on_main helper reused by task 8's start gate and task 10's frontier); never CI-green or branch/git-log inference.
current_flow: pr_ready.py is a story-level script with inline seal checks; there is no per-task seal or marker writer. task_marker_path (task 8) defines the marker path but nothing writes it. gh is available for PR creation.
